rationale: The brief, coherent responses feel natural and closely match the profile: reduced conversational initiation, preserved enjoyment of familiar activities and company, and a preference for time to formulate answers. Asking for clarification also feels realistic.

evidence.quote: Yes… it takes more effort now. I usually wait for my brother to call.
Not having to keep talking. Just sitting with my brother is nice.
I’m still thinking, even when I’m quiet.
